dimensions.evidenceB: The statements describe whoever remains in him or is born of God.
dimensions.label: Subject

dimensions.evidenceA: Having sin, sinning, confessing, and cleansing are named.
dimensions.evidenceB: Committing sin, remaining, divine birth, and righteous action are named.
dimensions.label: Action

evidence.observation: The letter says that claiming to have no sin is self-deception and calls for confession.
The letter says the one born of God does not commit sin and cannot sin because God’s seed remains.
evidence.role: Born of God does not sin

record.tension: The letter rejects a claim to have no sin while also saying the one born of God does not commit sin and cannot sin.
record.title: Can the same community have sin and not commit sin?
